shared_elements: ornate patterned costume with dense surface detail
figure holding/raising an object in hand
vertical staff-like or plant-like element beside the figure
low-relief profile with outlined contours and internal patterning
band of small repeated signs/motifs at the edge
justification: Both show a single elaborately costumed figure in strict profile with a tall headdress, densely patterned garments, an arm raised toward a vertical staff/plant element, and marginal rows of small repeated motifs — a broadly comparable 'ceremonial figure with attribute' scheme. But B's figure is winged, bearded, kneeling/striding beside a stylised rosette-bearing tree, while A's is a wingless standing figure flanked by columns of block-like glyph signs and different feather-plume regalia, so the specific iconography (wings, rosettes) has no counterpart.
